title: Marcos birthday caravan delivers gov’t services, aid in Ilocos Sur

blocks.text: VIGAN CITY, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — Residents in this province availed themselves of free government services and assistance programs at the CHAVIT Coliseum here on Monday, Sept. 14, as part of activities marking President Marcos’s birthday.
